definition: Ready to first observed text input or submitted selection; focus/mouse movement do not count.
calculation: first(first_input or submitted by observation_sequence).monotonic_ms - ready.monotonic_ms. Use rounded nonnegative monotonic differences within one browser document; conflicting context/order or absent endpoints yield blank.
applicability: One visit with both named browser endpoints.
missing_values: Blank means unavailable or inapplicable, not zero. Historical observations are not backfilled.

definition: Ready to first text/input change; not an estimate of mental reading time.
calculation: first_input.monotonic_ms - ready.monotonic_ms. Use rounded nonnegative monotonic differences within one browser document; conflicting context/order or absent endpoints yield blank.
applicability: Text-entry stages; blank is expected for chip-only selections.
missing_values: Blank means unavailable or inapplicable, not zero. Historical observations are not backfilled.

definition: First input to first submission, including pauses, not active typing time.
calculation: first_submitted.monotonic_ms - first_input.monotonic_ms. Use rounded nonnegative monotonic differences within one browser document; conflicting context/order or absent endpoints yield blank.
applicability: One visit with both named browser endpoints.
missing_values: Blank means unavailable or inapplicable, not zero. Historical observations are not backfilled.

definition: Ready to first submitted action, even if that action is rejected.
calculation: first_submitted.monotonic_ms - ready.monotonic_ms. Use rounded nonnegative monotonic differences within one browser document; conflicting context/order or absent endpoints yield blank.
applicability: One visit with both named browser endpoints.
missing_values: Blank means unavailable or inapplicable, not zero. Historical observations are not backfilled.

definition: Ready to the last submission in the visit with an accepted backend outcome.
calculation: last submitted where linked accepted=true: monotonic_ms - ready.monotonic_ms. Earlier rejected submissions and intervening waits are included. Use rounded nonnegative monotonic differences within one browser document; conflicting context/order or absent endpoints yield blank.
applicability: One visit with both named browser endpoints.
missing_values: Blank means unavailable or inapplicable, not zero. Historical observations are not backfilled.

definition: First input to the last submission in this visit accepted by the backend.
calculation: last accepted submission.monotonic_ms - first_input.monotonic_ms; includes pauses and any earlier request waits. Use rounded nonnegative monotonic differences within one browser document; conflicting context/order or absent endpoints yield blank.
applicability: One visit with both named browser endpoints.
missing_values: Blank means unavailable or inapplicable, not zero. Historical observations are not backfilled.

definition: Ready to recorded visit close; includes student and system time.
calculation: closed.monotonic_ms - ready.monotonic_ms. Use rounded nonnegative monotonic differences within one browser document; conflicting context/order or absent endpoints yield blank.
applicability: One visit with both named browser endpoints.
missing_values: Blank means unavailable or inapplicable, not zero. Historical observations are not backfilled.

definition: Total submit-to-request-finished waiting; a subset of system waiting, not additional time.
calculation: SUM(request_finished.monotonic_ms - submitted.monotonic_ms), paired by submission_id. Blank if ready is absent, any endpoint is missing, or observation_sequence has a gap; 0 for a ready visit with no submissions. Use rounded nonnegative monotonic differences within one browser document; conflicting context/order or absent endpoints yield blank.
applicability: One visit with both named browser endpoints.
missing_values: Blank means unavailable or inapplicable, not zero. Historical observations are not backfilled.

definition: Total submit-to-controls-ready waiting, including request, refresh and rendering.
calculation: SUM(controls_ready.monotonic_ms - submitted.monotonic_ms), paired by submission_id. Blank if ready is absent, any endpoint is missing, or observation_sequence has a gap; 0 for a ready visit with no submissions. Use rounded nonnegative monotonic differences within one browser document; conflicting context/order or absent endpoints yield blank.
applicability: One visit with both named browser endpoints.
missing_values: Blank means unavailable or inapplicable, not zero. Historical observations are not backfilled.

definition: Duration of captured hidden-to-visible pairs; overlaps other durations and is not additive to them.
calculation: SUM(visible.monotonic_ms - preceding unmatched hidden.monotonic_ms). Require ready, closed, contiguous sequence, and complete unambiguous pairs; otherwise blank. Complete visits with no hidden events yield 0. Use rounded nonnegative monotonic differences within one browser document; conflicting context/order or absent endpoints yield blank.
applicability: One visit with both named browser endpoints.
missing_values: Blank means unavailable or inapplicable, not zero. Historical observations are not backfilled.

definition: Observed document-hidden transitions during a visit.
calculation: COUNT(observation_kind=hidden) after event-ID deduplication.
applicability: Observed records only; absent events do not prove that an action did not occur.
missing_values: Zero means no matching event among the captured records, not verified absence of behavior. Check timing_limitations.

definition: Captured hidden-to-visible pairs, not total returns to the assessment across visits.
calculation: COUNT(visible events that have a preceding unmatched hidden event).
applicability: Observed records only; absent events do not prove that an action did not occur.
missing_values: Zero means no matching event among the captured records, not verified absence of behavior. Check timing_limitations.

definition: Window blur events, not proof of leaving the task.
calculation: COUNT(observation_kind=blur).
applicability: Observed records only; absent events do not prove that an action did not occur.
missing_values: Zero means no matching event among the captured records, not verified absence of behavior. Check timing_limitations.

definition: Observed browser offline transitions.
calculation: COUNT(observation_kind=offline).
applicability: Observed records only; absent events do not prove that an action did not occur.
missing_values: Zero means no matching event among the captured records, not verified absence of behavior. Check timing_limitations.

definition: Duration between captured browser offline/online signals; these do not prove server connectivity.
calculation: SUM(online.monotonic_ms - preceding unmatched offline.monotonic_ms). Require ready, closed, contiguous sequence, and complete unambiguous pairs; otherwise blank. Complete visits with no offline events yield 0. Use rounded nonnegative monotonic differences within one browser document; conflicting context/order or absent endpoints yield blank.
applicability: One visit with both named browser endpoints.
missing_values: Blank means unavailable or inapplicable, not zero. Historical observations are not backfilled.

definition: Observed submitted actions, including rejected attempts and manual retries.
